title: 第16章 前往市一中第17章 诡异的宿舍
content_zh:
：“不是？叫我去这所学校？可我要怎么进去啊。”
我一脸疑惑的问道。
刘天龙仿佛料到我会这般表情拍了拍我的肩膀，从一旁的抽屉里面掏出学生证，放在了我的眼前。
我看着眼前的学生证上面赫然写到了我的名字，而照片也是我高中时期拍的照片。
“好了，我已经处理好了，你只需要前往学校协助调查就行。”
刘天龙一脸认真的看着我，淡然的说道。
“好了，不要磨叽了，你们去这个学校主要的目的是调查一下那个女孩为什么会死亡。”
刘天龙说完便叫我们赶快去进行行动。
我们三人离开了酒楼出门打车来到学校，到达学校门口赵史拍了拍我的肩膀，看着我说道：“小子，我就在旁边的旅社住下了，发生任何情况，发生任何情况，第一时间给我发消息。”
我听了之后点了点头，看着眼前的高中，现在正值上课期间，高中鸦雀无声，显得有点像个空了一般。
我换下了刘天龙给我的校服，看着校服上面的市一中，从一旁的保安室走了进去。
门卫室的保安，睡意朦胧的打了一个哈欠，看见我走了进来便向我挥了挥手示意。
“你是哪个班的？怎么都上学这么久了才过来？”
保安看着我质问道。
我听了之后，他说我的学生证，保安接过了我的学生证，看了一眼便让我进去了。
啊，这么简单就可以进来？还是说刘天龙给的学生证，这么方便的吗？
刚踏入学校，我便感觉到迎面吹来一股凉风，寒风刺骨，让人些许不适，看来这所学校果然有问题。
我看了一眼学生证上面的班级高三二班，踏步向教学楼走去。
到达高三二班门口，别听见教室传来阵阵读书声，一名戴着眼镜的中年妇女站在讲台上，用着狠厉的眼神盯着台下。
而一旁的黑板上面写着距离高考还有三一四天，奋斗三年就为了高考。

“咚咚！”
我敲响了教室的门，向老师低头的问道：“老师你好，打扰一下，我是新来的转校生。”
讲台上的教师和全班的目光都是向我这边汇集。
“大家掌声欢迎一下徐枫，作为我们班新人来的一份子。”
中年教师把我带入了教室，向着很多同学介绍。
随后重点教室把我一个人安排在后面一个女生的旁边，众人看望着我，从讲台下慢慢向着座位走去。
我看着眼前的教室和周围的同学，时光飞逝，都忘了多久没有上过学了，没想到现在居然有了再次入学的机会。
“你好，我叫做赵美娜，很高兴认识你。”
我从讲台上走了下来，回到了座位上，旁边的女孩热情地向我问道。
我看向旁边的女孩扎着双马尾，脸上虽说是素颜，可是有一种学生时代的美。
“你好，我也很高兴认识你。”
content_en:
: "No? Ask me to go to this school? But how do I get in?"
I asked with a confused look on my face.
Liu Tianlong seemed to expect that I would have such an expression and patted my shoulder. He took out his student ID card from the drawer on the side and placed it in front of my eyes.
I looked at the student ID card in front of me with my name clearly written on it, and the photo was also taken during my high school days.
"Okay, I've taken care of it, you just need to go to the school to assist in the investigation."
Liu Tianlong looked at me seriously and said calmly.
"Okay, stop nagging. The main purpose of your going to this school is to investigate why the girl died."
After Liu Tianlong finished speaking, he asked us to take action quickly.
The three of us left the restaurant and took a taxi to the school. When we arrived at the school gate, Zhao Shi patted me on the shoulder, looked at me and said, "Boy, I'm staying at the hotel next door. If anything happens, please send me a message as soon as possible."
I nodded after listening and looked at the high school in front of me. It was during the school day and the high school was completely silent and seemed a bit empty.
I changed out of the school uniform that Liu Tianlong gave me, looked at the No. 1 Middle School on the uniform, and walked in from the security room on the side.
The security guard in the guard room yawned sleepily and waved to me when he saw me walking in.
"Which class are you in? Why have you been in school for so long before coming here?"
The security guard looked at me and asked.
After I listened, he asked me for my student ID card. The security guard took my student ID card, took a look at it, and let me in.
Ah, can you come in so easily? Or is it that the student ID card given by Liu Tianlong is so convenient?
As soon as I stepped into the school, I felt a cool breeze blowing in my face. The cold wind was biting and made me feel a little uncomfortable. It seemed that there was something wrong with this school.
I glanced at the class on my student ID card, Grade 3 and Grade 2, and walked towards the teaching building.
When I arrived at the door of Class 2, Grade 3, I heard the sound of reading coming from the classroom. A middle-aged woman wearing glasses stood on the podium, staring at the audience with stern eyes.
The blackboard on the side said that there are still three days to four days before the college entrance examination, and I have been working hard for three years just for the college entrance examination.
"Boom!"
I knocked on the classroom door, lowered my head to the teacher and asked, "Hello, teacher, excuse me, I am a new transfer student."
The eyes of the teacher on the podium and the whole class were all focused on me.
"Everyone applaud and welcome Xu Feng as a new member of our class."
The middle-aged teacher brought me into the classroom and introduced me to many classmates.
Then I was placed alone in the key classroom next to a girl in the back. Everyone looked at me and slowly walked towards my seat from under the podium.
I looked at the classroom in front of me and the classmates around me. Time flew by and I forgot how long it had been since I went to school. I didn't expect that I would have the opportunity to enroll again.
"Hello, my name is Zhao Meina. Nice to meet you."
I walked down from the podium and returned to my seat. The girl next to me asked me enthusiastically.
I looked at the girl next to me with her twin tails. Although her face was bare-faced, she had a student-era beauty.
"Hello, nice to meet you too."
